scientific_integrity.integrity: All finite counts and structural assertions are reproducible from the embedded programs, certificates, and recorded outputs. Sources are identified by their original public preprint dates rather than later revisions.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No extension to infinite graph families, other game rules, or simultaneous cover pebbling is proved. No external independent review. Unindexed prior calculations remain possible.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Exhaustive finite reachability recurrence covering all 38,760 distributions with at most six pebbles; independent breadth-first search in a distinct Fano-plane model, geometric class comparison, automorphism verification, and complete deterministic certificates.
scientific_integrity.theorem_scope: The fixed fourteen-vertex Fano-plane incidence graph; ordinary two-for-one pebbling for reachability, and explicitly defined separate size-preserving one-pebble relocations for configuration exchanges.

title: Optimal pebbling on the Heawood graph: four orbit types and fragmented one-pebble transfers
